summary: Packs 32-bit floating-point texture channel data into 8-bit RGBA pixels for lossless storage, or unpacks stored data back to float textures.

key_params.name: packtype
key_params.note: Direction and channel layout for packing or unpacking.

key_params.name: pack
key_params.note: Pack float channels into 8-bit RGBA pixels.

key_params.name: unpackrgbA
key_params.note: Unpack stored RGBA channels; official id uses a capital A.

key_params.name: resolution
key_params.note: Common TOP custom output width and height.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Common TOP output pixel format for downstream storage or unpacking.

common_gotchas: Use lossless file formats/codecs when storing packed data; lossy compression destroys packed float values.
Set Movie File Out output color space and Movie File In input color space to Passthrough.
Do not pass packed data through intermediate TOP processing before unpacking unless that operation is byte-preserving.
Pack mode works on any input pixel format but treats all channels as 32-bit floats for packing.
key_concepts: Packs 32-bit floating-point channel data into 8-bit RGBA pixels for lossless storage.
Unpack modes reconstruct R, RG, RGB, or RGBA 32-bit float textures from packed 8-bit pixels.
Packed output width is channel-count times input width while height remains unchanged.
Movie File Out and Movie File In color spaces must stay Passthrough so packed bytes are not modified.
